Class HostedScreen<T extends HostUI>

java.lang.Object
com.sbancuz.offscreen.window.HostedScreen<T>
Type Parameters:
T - concrete adapter retained by this entry
public final class HostedScreen<T extends HostUI> extends Object
Owns one adapter's layout and disposal bookkeeping inside a window's screen stack.

The adapter knows the GUI framework; this entry remembers whether it has been initialized at the current size and prevents disposing it twice. The stack owns scope entry/restoration around actions. This wrapper does not enter those scopes by itself. Use on the Minecraft client thread.

    • draw

      public void draw(net.minecraft.client.Minecraft mc, int mouseX, int mouseY, float partialTicks, long now)
      Delegates drawing while suppressing this screen's ordinary vanilla background. The marker is cleared even on failure. This single global marker is not a general-purpose nested drawing stack; callers draw hosted entries sequentially.
      Parameters:
      mc - current Minecraft client
      mouseX - pointer X in GUI units
      mouseY - pointer Y in GUI units from the top
      partialTicks - fractional tick for animation
      now - current frame timestamp in milliseconds
